FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Good questions.
Straight answers.

A useful place to start before your first call.

Get a Free EstimateCall (619) 507-4947
Are estimates free?+

Yes. E&S Quality Plumbing offers free estimates. Contact the team with your location and a description of the work to discuss the next steps.

Do you work on homes and commercial properties?+

Yes. Residential and commercial plumbing are both part of the company’s service offering.

What services can I ask about?+

Repairs, drain cleaning, water heaters, leak work, sewer connections, underground systems, and ADU plumbing. The Services directory explains these in more detail.

Where do you work?+

E&S serves San Diego County. Contact the team with your city or ZIP code to confirm coverage and current availability for your address.

Can you help with an ADU?+

Yes. E&S’s project highlights include ADU underground waste and vent installation in Point Loma. Share the plans and current stage of your build.

How do I arrange an appointment?+

Call (619) 507-4947 or use the estimate builder to prepare a text message. An appointment is confirmed directly by the team.

Do you offer after-hours emergency service?+

Call to ask about current availability. Response times and after-hours scheduling are confirmed directly.

Is every image a company project?+

No. Images identified as illustrative stock are examples of plumbing work, not photographs of completed E&S projects. See Instagram for original company project photos and updates.
